configurePresets.name: linux-core
configurePresets.description: Configure the pure-C++ core with the OCCT geometry kernel and Polyhedral-FEA mesher.

configurePresets.name: windows-core
configurePresets.displayName: Windows core (libchudware, Ninja + MSVC, OCCT off)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with MSVC. Run from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022' (or after vcvars64.bat) so cl/link are on PATH. OCCT off = the self-contained fast build; verified on Win11 + MSVC 14.44. See docs/reference/BUILD_WINDOWS.md.

configurePresets.name: windows-occt
configurePresets.displayName: Windows core + OCCT (libchudware, Ninja + MSVC, OCCT on)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with OCCT and Polyhedral-FEA on MSVC. The first configure downloads OCCT and the pinned BSD-3-Clause mesher source. Run from an x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 core (libchudware, Ninja + AppleClang, OCCT + Polyhedral-FEA)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with Homebrew OpenCASCADE and the pinned Polyhedral-FEA source. CEF is disabled because no Darwin CEF distribution is vendored.

configurePresets.name: macos-x86_64
configurePresets.displayName: macOS x86_64 core (libchudware, Ninja + AppleClang, OCCT + Polyhedral-FEA)
configurePresets.description: Configure the C++ core with Homebrew OpenCASCADE and the pinned Polyhedral-FEA source. CEF is disabled because no Darwin CEF distribution is vendored.

configurePresets.name: linux-aarch64-qemu
configurePresets.displayName: Linux aarch64 core, cross-built, tests under QEMU (OCCT + Polyhedral-FEA)
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile the core for aarch64 Linux with the GNU cross toolchain on an x86_64 Linux host; ctest runs all registered core tests through qemu-user (cmake/toolchains/qemu-aarch64-run.sh, private TMPDIR per test), with explicit test timeouts capped at 600 seconds. Use scripts/run_bounded.py to bound the whole ctest command to 1800 seconds and CHUDWARE_JOB_DEADLINE. Emulated, not native ARM hardware. Export CHUDWARE_ARM_SDK from scripts/build_arm_sdk.sh linux-aarch64 first; ARM children that re-exec themselves require the guest's qemu-aarch64 binfmt_misc registration. CHOLMOD is off because the ARM SDK carries no SuiteSparse; FEA uses the Eigen solver. LTO is off because these are qualification binaries, not shipping artifacts.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-cross
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 core, cross-compiled on an Intel Mac, COMPILE ONLY (OCCT + Polyhedral-FEA)
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile and link the core for arm64 macOS with AppleClang on an Intel Mac. Nothing built here can run on the build host and nothing is tested; native arm64 runtime belongs to the macos-arm64 preset on Apple silicon. Export CHUDWARE_ARM_SDK from scripts/build_arm_sdk.sh darwin-arm64 first. CHOLMOD is off because the ARM SDK carries no SuiteSparse; CEF is disabled because no Darwin CEF distribution is vendored. LTO is off: nothing built here ships, and LTO links would double the bounded build.
